title: Bug: font/text rendering is mangled after task 0702 glyph outline changes
description: Text rendering is completely mangled in the editor or published SWFs. Likely regressed by task 0702 changes to packages/swf/src/fonts.ts and packages/swf/src/text.ts (DefineFont3 EM scale fix, TEXTRECORD field order fix, DefineEditText flag bits). Need to triage: (1) is it broken in the editor canvas, in published SWF in Ruffle, or both? (2) which specific change in 0702 caused it. Cross-check against the text-rendering.spec.ts E2E test — if that still passes, the SWF encoding is correct and the issue is in the authoring UI renderer.
